title: 星鏈與低軌通訊星系
summary: 以通訊星系的公開架構探索衛星平台、鏈路、地面服務與太空永續。
summaryEn: Explore public constellation architecture, satellite buses, links, ground services and space sustainability.
scope: 公開原理的分層工程教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務，並非原廠配方、施工圖或操作許可。
scopeEn: A layered course in public engineering principles. Steps are verifiable learning tasks, not vendor recipes, construction drawings, or operating authorization.

steps.title: 建立服務需求
steps.objective: 完成「建立服務需求」的概念模型與工程檢核。
steps.objectiveEn: Build and review the conceptual model for define service needs.

knowledge.title: 核心原理
knowledge.text: 延遲、容量與可用性是不同指標，不能以單一速度代表全部。
knowledge.textEn: Latency, capacity and availability differ; one speed figure cannot represent all of them.

knowledge.title: 總工程師檢核
knowledge.text: 為教學網路建立三種指標。
knowledge.textEn: Define three metrics for the learning network.

steps.check: 為教學網路建立三種指標。

quiz.question: 哪個敘述最直接說明「建立服務需求」的核心原理？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains define service needs?
options: 延遲、容量與可用性是不同指標，不能以單一速度代表全部。
較低軌道可縮短傳播距離，但衛星相對地面持續移動。
星系服務依賴衛星、地面站、使用者終端及網際網路互連。
optionsEn: Latency, capacity and availability differ; one speed figure cannot represent all of them.
Lower orbits shorten propagation paths while satellites move relative to the ground.
Service depends on satellites, gateways, user terminals and internet interconnection.
quiz.explanation: 延遲、容量與可用性是不同指標，不能以單一速度代表全部。
quiz.explanationEn: Latency, capacity and availability differ; one speed figure cannot represent all of them.
